name: Nancy Drew: Last Train to Blue Moon Canyon

locations.note: At the stop in Copper Gorge, Nancy meets Fatima at the museum and taffy shop and finds her family in Jake Hurley's letters.
Left at Brimstone Canyon near Blue Moon Canyon, where Jake Hurley's train was found in 1903, Nancy opens his lost mine and finds his skeleton beside a letter from Abraham Lincoln.

routes.name: The train west
routes.note: Lori Girard's chartered train west to Copper Gorge and on to Blue Moon Canyon.
